'''Dath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] child who lived on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was born into a life of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], but was rescued shortly after his fourth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] by the exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]]. Master Thorla swept Dath away and offered him a place at [[The Enclave]] which Thorla had built for former slaves. Dath, with nowhere else to go, accepted with a gracious heart. While at The Enclave, Dath met other Twi'lek children whom Master Thorla had rescued from slavery, and he became very close friends with [[Tror]] and [[Meeva]].
